open(p,'w').write('''def transform(grid):
    # Decode the two color sequences at the bottom; extend each anchored sequence
    # to the left and right from the anchor in the sequence's natural order.
    ref=[v for v in grid[-1] if v]
    # The zero gap separates two independent cyclic words.
    row=grid[-1]; gap=next((i for i,v in enumerate(row) if v==0),len(row))
    left=[v for v in row[:gap] if v]
    right=[v for v in row[gap:] if v]
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]

        for c,v in enumerate(grid[r]):
            if not v: continue
            seq=left if v in left else right if v in right else ref
            if v not in seq: continue
            k=seq.index(v)
            start=c-k
            for j,x in enumerate(seq):
                if 0<=start+j<len(grid[r]): out[r][start+j]=x
    return out
''')
